overview.title: What is Our World?
overview.text: Our World is a venture collective building open digital infrastructure. Its ventures include the Zanzibar Digital Free Zone and an XR game platform.

overview.title: Who joins Our World?
overview.text:
Our World attracts builders, developers, and digital entrepreneurs who want to own their data and contribute to decentralized infrastructure or open-source XR technology.

Participants range from those seeking digital business formation through the [Zanzibar Digital Free Zone](https://zdfz.live) to developers integrating the OASIS API into new applications and games.

history.text:
Our World emerged from over two decades of infrastructure work by a founding team with a track record of building and exiting enterprise technology companies. Co-founder Kristof De Spiegeleer and the core team built and sold five companies between 2005 and 2015, with acquirers including Veritas Symantec, Verizon/Equinix, Telenet, Sun Microsystems/Oracle, and Western Digital. Their infrastructure powered UEFA, NASA, and World Cup events before the exits.

Those ventures shaped OurWorld's founding philosophy: build infrastructure that returns digital control to individuals and communities rather than consolidating it in large platforms. The collective launched to pursue this through three main ventures - ThreeFold (decentralized internet infrastructure), the Zanzibar Digital Free Zone (a fully digital special economic zone in Tanzania), and Geomind (AI and geospatial solutions).

A parallel project, Our World The Game, began development in 2019 as an open-source XR/IR (extended reality/infinite reality) educational game built on the OASIS API, a universal connector designed to bridge decentralized protocols. The game's MVP and STAR demo were released in December 2025.

location:
Our World operates across two primary geographies. The [Zanzibar Digital Free Zone (ZDFZ)](https://zdfz.live) in Zanzibar, Tanzania, serves as OurWorld's flagship special economic zone where digital businesses can incorporate and operate under a simplified digital jurisdiction. Zanzibar's government has positioned the zone to attract global technology investment and reduce the island's reliance on tourism.

The software arm - Our World The Game - is developed by a UK-based team. ThreeFold, OurWorld's decentralized infrastructure venture, has community-operated nodes distributed across 40+ countries.
duration: Our World does not run fixed-cohort programs. Participation in the [Zanzibar Digital Free Zone](https://zdfz.live) is ongoing once a business is registered. Contribution to Our World The Game is open-ended - developers can join at any time via the project's open-source repositories and community channels. ThreeFold node operators participate on a continuous basis.
amenities: Access to ThreeFold decentralized grid (750+ nodes, 40+ countries)
Zanzibar Digital Free Zone business incorporation and cross-border compliance tools
OASIS API for connecting and building decentralized applications
STAR development kit (ODK) for XR/IR app and game creation
HoloNET integration for distributed peer-to-peer applications
Open-source GitHub repositories and developer documentation
Community access via Discord and Telegram channels
Karma system for rewarding positive contributions in the Our World game ecosystem

howToEnter.text:
For OurWorld venture collaboration, contact the team at info@ourworld.tf or reach out via the [official website](https://www.ourworld.tf).

To contribute to Our World The Game or the OASIS API, the project is fully open source - browse the repositories and join the developer community on Discord or Telegram as listed on [ourworldthegame.com](https://www.ourworldthegame.com).

For Zanzibar Digital Free Zone business formation, visit [zdfz.live](https://zdfz.live) for registration details.

faqs.question: What is Our World?
faqs.answer: Our World is a venture collective building open digital sovereignty infrastructure. It operates two main platforms: [OurWorld.tf](https://www.ourworld.tf), which focuses on ventures including ThreeFold, the Zanzibar Digital Free Zone, and Geomind; and [Our World The Game](https://www.ourworldthegame.com), an open-source XR/IR game built on the OASIS API.

faqs.question: What is the Zanzibar Digital Free Zone?
faqs.answer: The [Zanzibar Digital Free Zone (ZDFZ)](https://zdfz.live) is a fully digital special economic zone in Zanzibar, Tanzania, enabling digital businesses to incorporate, operate, and trade cross-border through integrated digital infrastructure. It was co-founded by Chris Camponovo and Florian Fournier as part of the OurWorld ecosystem.

faqs.question: What is Our World The Game?
faqs.answer: Our World The Game is an open-source next-generation XR/IR (extended reality/infinite reality) educational game and social platform. It uses a Karma system to reward players for real-world positive actions, and is built on the OASIS API - a universal connector designed to bridge decentralized protocols. The MVP and STAR demo were released in December 2025.

faqs.question: Who founded Our World?
faqs.answer: OurWorld.tf was co-founded by Kristof De Spiegeleer (CEO) and a team including Adnan Fatayerji, Chris Camponovo, and Florian Fournier. The founding team previously built and exited five enterprise technology companies between 2005 and 2015. Our World The Game was founded by developer dellams, with Max Gershfield (CMO/COO) and ALASKANmagpie (Community) as key team members.

faqs.question: What is ThreeFold?
faqs.answer: ThreeFold is a decentralized internet infrastructure network with 750+ community-operated nodes across 40+ countries. It uses Zero OS, Quantum-Safe Storage, and the Mycelium Network to let users deploy workloads without relying on centralized cloud providers. It is a core venture in the OurWorld ecosystem and the infrastructure foundation for Project Mycelium.

faqs.question: What is Project Mycelium?
faqs.answer: Project Mycelium is the next evolution of ThreeFold's infrastructure, announced in November 2025. It introduces sovereign cloud capabilities, AI agent-based workloads, and a dual-token economic model using AUR and SPORE tokens. A Mycelium Marketplace is scheduled to launch in 2026.

faqs.question: What is the OASIS API?
faqs.answer: The OASIS API is a universal API developed by the Our World The Game team that connects decentralized protocols, platforms, and applications. It underpins the Our World platform and is available to third-party developers who want to build satellite apps and games that interoperate with the Our World ecosystem.

faqs.question: Is Our World open source?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our World The Game and the OASIS API are fully open source, with repositories on GitHub. OurWorld.tf also states open-source tooling as a core operating principle. Developers can contribute to the codebase or build new apps using the OASIS API and STAR ODK.

faqs.question: Where is Our World based?
faqs.answer: Our World operates across multiple locations. OurWorld.tf and the Zanzibar Digital Free Zone are based in Zanzibar, Tanzania. The Our World The Game development team is based in the UK. ThreeFold's infrastructure spans community-operated nodes in 40+ countries worldwide.

faqs.question: How do I get involved with Our World?
faqs.answer: For venture collaboration with OurWorld.tf, contact info@ourworld.tf or visit the [OurWorld website](https://www.ourworld.tf). For developer contribution to Our World The Game, visit [ourworldthegame.com](https://www.ourworldthegame.com) and join the Discord or Telegram community. For business formation in the Zanzibar Digital Free Zone, visit [zdfz.live](https://zdfz.live).
